name: OCRBench
intro: OCRBench 论文包含两种必须区分的产物：覆盖 29 个 OCR 相关数据集的大规模实验，以及用于便捷复现的紧凑版基准。紧凑版由 1,000 条人工核验、校正并补充备选答案的图像—问题—答案组成，按文本识别、场景文本 VQA、文档 VQA、关键信息提取和手写数学表达式识别五个组件计分。
org: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Microsoft Research, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Chinese Academy of Sciences, South China University of Technology
build_method: 29 数据集实验池与紧凑版分流, 五组件固定配额, 人工核验与答案校正
task_type: 视觉问答, 文本识别, 关键信息提取
scale: 紧凑版 1,000 条问答；大规模实验覆盖 29 个数据集；5 个计分组件
task_type_en: Visual QA, text recognition, key information extraction
build_method_en: 29-dataset Study versus Compact-release Split, Fixed Five-component Quotas, Manual Verification and Answer Correction
intro_en: The OCRBench paper contains two artifacts that must not be conflated: a broad study spanning 29 OCR-related datasets and a compact benchmark released for convenient reproduction. The compact artifact has 1,000 image-question-answer rows whose answers were manually verified, corrected, and expanded with alternatives; it is scored across text recognition, scene-text VQA, document VQA, key information extraction, and handwritten mathematical expression recognition.

drawio_review_note: Paper/source audit fixed on 2026-07-22. The primary paper is arXiv:2305.07895v7, corresponding to the final Science China Information Sciences article DOI 10.1007/s11432-024-4235-6; the reviewed v7 PDF has SHA-256 4cc667c0bb143e5c854c6d6889194999a3bb841943a888d1ff6684d980d76b42. Sections 3.1 and 3.3 and Appendix A were checked against the diagram. Released data and scorer behavior were checked at official Yuliang-Liu/MultimodalOCR commit 86d091f0e3cadd97e98f77ef9f5ecf7e392452c5. The fixed OCRBench/OCRBench/OCRBench.json has SHA-256 df75957e75ea052e9f38f2c67a4f6676103998517345cf49ef7d03b62c835864 and exactly 1,000 rows; the public echo840/OCRBench Hugging Face mirror is fixed at revision 92a54bd1384387c178d5a07140a2d85e0a3d12e1 and also reports 1,000 test rows. The audit explicitly separates the paper's broad 29-dataset study from compact OCRBench. For the broad study, the paper defines a unified ground-truth containment criterion, says questions with answers shorter than four symbols are filtered from all datasets, samples 3,000 questions from some large datasets, and creates two 3,000-image controls from the IIIT5K dictionary: semantic text keeps dictionary words and non-semantic text shuffles the same characters. Those operations support FullTest and Tables 1-2; the paper does not publish a deterministic algorithm, seed, or trace mapping the broad pool to every compact item. This boundary matters: direct inspection of the fixed 1,000-row JSON finds six rows with at least one alternative gold shorter than four characters and two rows whose every gold alternative is shorter than four characters. The diagram therefore does not misrepresent the broad-study length filter as a proven compact-release gate. Appendix Table 5 and the fixed JSON agree on the compact quotas. Text recognition contributes 300 items: regular, irregular, artistic, handwriting, digit-string, and non-semantic recognition each contribute 50. Scene-text VQA contributes 200, with 50 each from STVQA, TextVQA, English ESTVQA, and OCRVQA. Document VQA contributes 200, with 50 each from DocVQA, augmented ChartQA, human ChartQA, and InfographicVQA. KIE contributes 200 split as SROIE 67, FUNSD 66, and POIE 67. HME100K contributes 100 HMER items. The paper preserves task-specific English, Chinese, digit-string, key-to-value, and LaTeX prompts; compact KIE questions append the instruction to answer directly using text in the image. Every compact answer was manually checked, inaccurate ground truth was corrected, and alternative valid answers were added. The official example scorer, whose fixed file SHA-256 is 70194609de34d25e89b9c3b397e854729027d28b8a28d25670cdcf90a6f738cf, lowercases, trims, and flattens line breaks for non-HMER rows; for HMER it removes spaces and line breaks without lowercasing. It checks every alternative gold as a substring of the prediction, counts a correct row as one, and sums recognition 300, scene VQA 200, document VQA 200, KIE 200, and HMER 100 to a maximum of 1,000. The repository provides a model-integration template rather than a paper-wide generation configuration, so the diagram does not invent decoding parameters. JSON, images, code, and a public leaderboard are available. The repository MIT license covers its code, while the fixed HF card does not declare a dataset license and the benchmark repackages many upstream datasets; downstream use must follow the original source terms rather than assuming that one repository license clears all images. Formal publication evidence [site-a11x-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3085×801 (English) and 3085×801 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3083×799 and 3083×799. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
